question: If in a code language, 'SOLO' is written as 'TMOK', then how will 'ROSE' be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/414ad7ab7959394e3a4aaa7cddd92cc84a2c71869686182e93742825bc88695a.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Every letter is shifted by +1, -2, +3, -4.**

 
• **SOLO' is written as 'TMOK**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8133cbffa080391cb170add94cdffb4a518cb5fdab87f11baa4f86b00db5eb47.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **ROSE = ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e73a93f6a1ecb51101b019fe9741a2e4c4ba3655894f0652e85fdf657e36795.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SMVA".**
